office_does: A State Senator writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets for a four-year term, and the Senate confirms the governor's appointments.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Republican State Rep. Jeremie Dufault of Selah is the only candidate for the 15th District Senate seat.

candidates.summary: Republican State Representative for the 15th District, former Selah City Council member and Army Reserve JAG officer; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: State Representative, 15th District Position 2; former Selah City Council member [S1][S2]
Voted against the 2026 tax on income over $1 million, saying "these taxes start small and grow" [S3][S5]
Voted against ESHB 1296 (2025), the changes to the parental-rights law that I-1 would undo [S4]
Lieutenant colonel in the U.S. Army Reserve JAG Corps; served in Kuwait and Afghanistan [S1]
